_readme: Seed knowledge about how specific retailers expose reviews. Read by
services/reviewSiteProfileService as the fallback layer under the DB, so a
fresh deploy starts knowing what we already learned instead of re-probing.
EVERY ENTRY HERE WAS VERIFIED AGAINST THE LIVE SITE — do not add guesses.
The runtime writes what it learns to the ReviewSiteProfile collection; when
a learned profile proves stable, promote it into this file so it survives a
database reset and is reviewable in a PR.
idSource/idTrim answer 'which id are this store's reviews filed under':
take the value from idSource and drop idTrim trailing characters.
Fields: platform, idSource, idTrim, ldSource, hints, reviewsSeen, learnedFrom.

hints.note: PDP is Next.js App Router: the ld+json tag is serialised into the RSC flight payload, doubly escaped, so a script-tag scan finds nothing. PowerReviews keys are under powerReviewsConfig:{groupId,merchantId,apiKey} — NOT prApiKey/prMerchantId. Reviews are filed against the 6-digit style (130046), not the 9-digit colour pid (130046042) nor the 13-digit sku.
hints.merchantIdIsNotGroupId: groupId 524780421 returns 401 'api key is invalid for this merchant'; merchantId 1443032450 is the one the read URL wants.

hints.note: Reviews are filed under the PDP slug id (pimprod2054180) from JSON-LD productID / the canonical URL. The SKU (2644401) returns a valid but EMPTY response, so the SKU must not be trusted as the page_id.
hints.keys: prApiKey / prMerchantId / prMerchantGroupId in an inline React page-state blob.

hints.note: Publishes rich snippets, so tier 1 alone yields the aggregate plus ~6 reviews. Nested review nodes use a BARE `type` key instead of `@type`.
hints.familyRollup: BV is configured with BV_FE_FAMILY, so a query for one product returns reviews for every sibling in the furniture family with an identical TotalResults. Exact-ProductId rows are preferred; family rows are flagged.

hints.note: Renders reviews entirely client-side — ZERO aggregateRating in the server HTML, so tier 1 gets nothing and tier 2/3 are the only routes. The BV product id is still server-rendered on the container div (data-bv-product-id).
hints.rateLimit: Shopify's edge 429s datacenter egress on this store; PDP fetches from cloud IPs may fail regardless of tier.

hints.note: Rich snippets carry the aggregate plus a couple of reviews (2 of 81) — the rest need tier 2. Was Judge.me at time of verification; apps churn, so installation is always re-checked from the page rather than trusted from this file.
